The '''1982–83 Cypriot First Division''' was the 44th season of the Cypriot top-level [[Association football|football]] league. [[AC Omonia|Omonia]] won their 12th title. 

==Format==
Fourteen teams participated in the 1982–83 Cypriot First Division. All teams played against each other twice, once at their home and once away. The team with the most points at the end of the season crowned champions. The last two teams were relegated to the [[1983–84 Cypriot Second Division]].

The champions ensured their participation in the [[1983–84 European Cup]] and the runners-up in the [[1983–84 UEFA Cup]].

==Changes from previous season==
[[Keravnos B.C.|Keravnos]] and [[Evagoras Paphos]] were relegated from previous season and played in the [[1982–83 Cypriot Second Division]]. They were replaced by the first two teams of the [[1981–82 Cypriot Second Division]], [[Alki Larnaca F.C.|Alki Larnaca]] and [[Aris Limassol F.C.|Aris Limassol]].
